book.name: IBELIU
book.title: ME IBELIU ꞌIDI LETA YESU MANUNA

content: ꞌEtoseyana nina Yaubada ꞌenega
ꞌEnega ꞌilobweneda be ona nidi tanonodiya tanuwaꞌiꞌisidi, ta geyaꞌabo tanuwanuwa pupuledi.
Lowa aniloseyao Yaubada ꞌina ona sisimanena tomota ꞌediya, ta ona nina ona ꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌenega ꞌabo tomota nigeya simulimuliye ꞌidi toꞌumalinao ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌana eꞌisa siloba.

ꞌAboꞌada wate ꞌabo ꞌetoseyana nina sinabwana taguitoyasei, bwaꞌomatana taloba, ta nigeya kapekapeyana tadedena ꞌenega. Ona nina ꞌetoseyana manuna ꞌida ꞌInapwana Yesu ꞌigimisimana apwesena, ꞌenega ꞌina onao ꞌana togimi nonoyao ꞌaboꞌada siꞌebwaꞌeda.

Ta Yaubada wate ꞌieꞌita ꞌaene ona nina ona ꞌaiꞌaila, nate weꞌiweꞌiyaya be edeedede be guinuwa waiwaidi ꞌediyega, ta wate Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌina eguyai ꞌedaya ꞌenega. Ta ꞌina ꞌebwaya nidi Yaubada ꞌina nuwanuwa nadigega, ga Yaluyaluwa Tabuna yage nidi ꞌedaya ꞌieguyaiyedi.
ꞌAda Toꞌetoseyana ꞌina ꞌelouya manuda
Niꞌatu ꞌaeonemi sena nina ꞌetamo talobai manuna, ta Yaubada aniloseyao geyaꞌabo ꞌidi loina ꞌiꞌebwaꞌebwaꞌedi sena nina ꞌenaya,
ta esi tomota ꞌebweu ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena, manuna Buki Tabu ꞌena ꞌisimanena, ꞌigwae, “Yaubada ye, to tomota tauna be ꞌenega manuna ꞌunuwanuwa? Ta yaita sana tauna tomota natuna ga ꞌuꞌitaꞌitaꞌiꞌisi?
ꞌEnega tuta kukupana namo manuna ꞌusaꞌu ebusiyena, aniloseyao ꞌagulaudiya, ta muliyega ꞌana ꞌamayaba be ꞌana tupu sinabwana ꞌuꞌebwaꞌena.
Ta waiwai wate ꞌuꞌebwaꞌena be yage maiboꞌadi ꞌiloinedi.” Ta ꞌina ꞌebeloina yage maiboꞌana manuna. Ta nigeya gete tuga, ta maꞌetamo esi be yage maiboꞌadi ꞌediya ꞌida loina.

Ta Yesu esi niꞌatu taꞌitena, ꞌaene tuta kukupana namo ꞌena ꞌimiyaebusi aniloseyao ꞌubunidiya, ta muliyega ꞌana ꞌamayaba be ꞌana tupu sinabwana ꞌilobedi ꞌina ꞌelouya be ꞌina mwawasa ꞌediyega. Nate Yaubada ꞌina oboboma ꞌedaya, manuna Yesu mwawasa ꞌana ꞌelouya ꞌilotoona maiboꞌada manuda.

Yaubada yage maiboꞌadi ꞌimweluluidi tauna manuna, ꞌenega nuwanuwana natunao yauyaudi ꞌiꞌauꞌewedima tauna ꞌina sena esaesa ꞌenaya, ta ꞌilobwenena be Yaubada nina ꞌada Toꞌetoseyana ꞌida gieꞌesase, manuna ꞌelouya sinabwana ꞌilotoona, ta tuwa tuga ꞌieꞌalamaꞌiꞌita, ga ꞌenega ꞌina bubuna maiboꞌana ꞌesasena.
Yesu nina ꞌada Toꞌetoseyana ga ꞌaboꞌada wate ꞌigieꞌesaseda, ta tauna be ꞌaboꞌada Yaubada ꞌenega tamai, ꞌenega geyaꞌabo Yesu ꞌiomayamaya manuda, ta esi ꞌiꞌawaꞌawa tasineda,
manuna ꞌina ona Tamana ꞌenaya, ꞌigwae, “ꞌAmu esana yada simane tasigwao ꞌediya, be deliegogona solanaya yatupuyo.”
Ta wate ꞌigwae, “Tauna ꞌena ꞌigu emisa yasaꞌu.” Ta wate ꞌigwae, “Gogama nidi Yaubada ꞌiꞌebwaꞌeguya niꞌatu maꞌegwao ꞌamiyami.”

Onaꞌaiꞌaila, Yesu ꞌina gogamao ꞌaboꞌada tomota maesiyoda be malalada, ꞌenega Yesu wate ꞌietomotai ga tomota oona ꞌiꞌewena ga ꞌimwawasa, be ꞌaene ꞌina mwawasega Seitani ꞌiloesawali, be Seitani ꞌina loina mwawasa manuna wate ꞌiloesawali.
Ta mwawasa ꞌana matauta be ꞌina yona waiwaina ꞌida tuta maiboꞌana ꞌediyega ꞌiꞌetoseyeda.
ꞌEtoseyana nina nigeya aniloseyao manudi ta esi ꞌaboꞌada Ebelaamo tubunao manuda.

ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌietomotai ꞌaboꞌada tasinao nadigega, ga ꞌietotaliya sinabwana ma ina ꞌatenuwaꞌoleꞌole manuda, ga Yaubada ꞌina guinuwa ꞌena ꞌietapewa, ta ꞌitaliya ꞌida bubuna toꞌumalidi manudi be ꞌaene Yaubada ꞌida nuwataudi.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, Yesu baleꞌuya miyamwau ta ꞌebetoo yauna ꞌilobedi, ꞌenega ꞌabo Seitani ꞌitooda, Yesu niꞌatu ꞌebetoo nidi ꞌimwalamwalatonidi, be kapekapeyana ꞌediyega ꞌiꞌetoseyeda.
